First, convert 36 weeks and 4 days to days:  
36 weeks = 36 × 7 = 252 days  
Add 4 days → 256 days before 1278-08-21.

Subtract 256 days from 1278-08-21:  
August has 31 days, so 256 days before Aug 21 goes into previous months.  
From Aug 21 back 11 days → Aug 10.  
Remaining 245 days earlier.  
1278 is not a leap year (divisible by 2 but not by 4 in Julian calendar? Actually 1278 Julian: leap year rule every 4 years, so 1276 leap, 1280 leap, so 1278 not leap).  
Go back through 1278:  
July 31 days → back 31 to July 10 (from Aug 10), remaining 214.  
June 30 → back 30 to June 10, remaining 184.  
May 31 → back 31 to May 10, remaining 153.  
April 30 → back 30 to April 10, remaining 123.  
March 31 → back 31 to March 10, remaining 92.  
February 28 → back 28 to February 10, remaining 64.  
January 31 → back 31 to January 10, remaining 33.  
December 1277 has 31 days → back 31 to December 10, remaining 2.  
Back 2 more days → December 8, 1277.

FINAL_ANSWER: 1277-12-08
